description_en: Creates a custom Auto Scaling policy
description_zh: 创建自定义弹性伸缩策略
kebab_example: aliyun emr put-auto-scaling-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --node-group-id ng-869471354ecd0000 --scaling-rules '["example-string"]' --constraints example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutAutoScalingPolicy

element_fields.help_en: The name of the rule. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string
element_fields.help_zh: 规则名称。必填参数，不允许为空字符串
element_fields.name: rule_name

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the scaling rule. This parameter is required. Valid values:

- TIME\_TRIGGER: time-based scaling.

- METRICS\_TRIGGER: load-based scaling
element_fields.help_zh:
伸缩规则类型。必填参数。取值范围：
- TIME_TRIGGER：按时间伸缩。
- METRICS_TRIGGER：按负载伸缩
element_fields.name: trigger_type

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the scaling activity. This parameter is required. Valid values:

- SCALE\_OUT: scale-out.

- SCALE\_IN: scale-in
element_fields.help_zh:
伸缩活动类型。必填参数。取值范围：
- SCALE_OUT：扩容。
- SCALE_IN：缩容
element_fields.name: activity_type

element_fields.help_en: The adjustment value. This parameter is required and must be a positive integer. It specifies the number of instances to add for a scale-out activity or remove for a scale-in activity
element_fields.help_zh: 调整值。必填参数，需要为正数，代表需要扩容或者缩容的实例数量
element_fields.name: adjustment_value

fields.help_en: The execution time of the scaling rule. This parameter is required. The value is a string in the HH:MM format
fields.help_zh: 伸缩规则执行时间。必填参数。HH:MM格式字符串
fields.name: launch_time

fields.help_en: The timestamp that specifies the end time. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 结束时间戳。单位为毫秒
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The frequency of executing the specified rule whose trigger mode is scaling by time. Valid values:

*   DAILY
*   WEEKLY
*   MONTHLY
fields.help_zh:
指定时间规则的执行类型。取值范围：
- DAILY：按天重复。
- WEEKLY：按周重复。
- MONTHLY：按月重复
fields.name: recurrence_type

fields.help_en: The timestamp that specifies the start time. This parameter is required. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 开始时间戳。必填参数。单位为毫秒
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The number of recurrences of the scheduled task. The value of this parameter depends on the value of RecurrenceType.

*   If the RecurrenceType parameter is set to DAILY, you can specify only one value for this parameter. Valid values: 1 to 31.
*   If the RecurrenceType parameter is set to WEEKLY, you can specify multiple values for this parameter and separate them with commas (,). The values MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, and SUN indicate the days from Monday to Sunday. For example, the value MON,FRI,SUN stands for Monday, Friday, and Sunday.
*   If the RecurrenceType parameter is set to MONTHLY, the value of this parameter is in the A-B or A,B format. The values of A and B are both in the range of 1 to 31. If you use the A-B format, the value of B must be greater than the value of A
fields.help_zh:
重复执行定时任务的数值。具体取值取决于RecurrenceType设置。
- RecurrenceType取DAILY时，只能填一个数值，取值范围：1~31。
- RecurrenceType取WEEKLY时，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。周一到周天分别用MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN代替。例如，MON,FRI,SUN代表周一、周五、周天。
- RecurrenceType取MONTHLY时，格式为A-B或者A,B。A和B的取值范围都为1~31，如果使用A-B时B必须大于A
fields.name: recurrence_value

fields.help_en: The time period during which a scheduled task can be retried after it fails. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 3600
fields.help_zh: 定时任务触发操作失败后，在此时间内重试。单位为秒，取值范围：0~3600
fields.name: launch_expiration_time

fields.help_en: The cooldown interval. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 10800
fields.help_zh: 冷却时间。 单位为秒。取值范围：0~10800
fields.name: cool_down_interval

element_fields.help_en: The end time. Valid values: 00:00 to 23:59
element_fields.name: end_time

element_fields.help_en: The start time. Valid values: 00:00 to 23:59
element_fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The number of times that the statistics are collected. This parameter is required. Valid values: 1 to 5
fields.help_zh: 统计次数。必填参数，取值范围：1~5
fields.name: evaluation_count

fields.help_en: The time window for statistics. This parameter is required. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 30 to 1800
fields.help_zh: 统计窗口。必填参数，单位为秒。取值范围30~1800
fields.name: time_window

element_fields.help_en: The name of the metric. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. You can view the metric name in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445658.html
element_fields.help_zh: 指标名称。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。您可以在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445658.html中查看指标名称
element_fields.name: metric_name

element_fields.help_en:
The comparison operator. This parameter is required. Valid values:

*   EQ: equal to
*   NE: not equal to
*   GT: greater than
*   LT: less than
*   GE: greater than or equal to
*   LE: less than or equal to
element_fields.help_zh:
比较符。必填参数。取值范围：
- EQ：等于。
- NE：不等于。
- GT：大于。
- LT：小于。
- GE：大于等于。
- LE：小于等于
element_fields.name: comparison_operator

element_fields.help_en:
The name of the statistic. This parameter is required. Valid values:

*   MAX
*   MIN
*   AVG
element_fields.help_zh:
统计量名称。必填参数。取值范围：
- MAX：最大值。
- MIN：最小值。
- AVG：平均值
element_fields.name: statistics

element_fields.help_en: The value of the tag This parameter is optional and can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。非必填，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或者```https://```
element_fields.name: value

element_fields.help_en: The key of the tag. This parameter is required and cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签键。必填参数，不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以```aliyun```和```acs:```开头，不能包含```http://```或 ```https://```
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The tags for the metrics of a partition. This parameter is available for only metrics that contain ByPartition. For other metrics, leave this parameter empty
element_fields.help_zh:
指标分区标签列表

### 对于带 queue 的指标

默认值：

标签键（key）：queue_name。值（value）：root。

当您使用带有队列的指标时，您可以设置 queue_name 标签，指定所属的队列。确保输入完整的队列层级名称。

示例

指标名：yarn_resourcemanager_queue_AvailableVCoresPercentage

标签：
`queue_name: root.default.a`

### 对于带 partition 的指标

默认值：
标签键（key）：无。值（value）：无。
> 对于带有分区的指标，必须设置 partition_name 标签且明确指定分区名称。

示例

指标名：yarn_cluster_availMemoryMBByPartition

标签：`partition_name: DEFAULT_PARTITION`
